name: check-and-units
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && bun run check && bun test core/lemma-cuts.test.ts kernel/lemma-cut.test.ts

name: lean-count-cuts
cmd: cd lean-kernel && TC=~/.elan/toolchains/leanprover--lean4---v4.34.0 && export LEAN_PATH="$PWD:$TC/lib/lean" && "$TC/bin/lean" -o Count.olean Count.lean && "$TC/bin/lean" -o CountMachine.olean CountMachine.lean && "$TC/bin/lean" ../research/track-k/LemmaCuts.lean && "$TC/bin/lean" ../research/track-k/ReviewEdges.lean

name: counted-library
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun lean-kernel/count-examples.ts lean-kernel; cd lean-kernel; TC=~/.elan/toolchains/leanprover--lean4---v4.34.0; export LEAN_PATH="$PWD:$TC/lib/lean"; for m in Count CountMachine GhostMap; do "$TC/bin/lean" -o "$m.olean" "$m.lean"; done; "$TC/bin/lean" CountExamples.lean

name: expanded-conformance
cmd: set -e; bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null; bun lean-kernel/conformance.ts --lemma-cuts > lean-kernel/LemmaConformance.lean; bun lean-kernel/conformance.ts --lemma-cuts --public > lean-kernel/PublicLemma.lean; cd lean-kernel; TC=~/.elan/toolchains/leanprover--lean4---v4.34.0; export LEAN_PATH="$PWD:$TC/lib/lean"; for m in Count CountMachine GhostMap; do "$TC/bin/lean" -o "$m.olean" "$m.lean"; done; "$TC/bin/lean" LemmaConformance.lean; "$TC/bin/lean" PublicLemma.lean

name: c14
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && bun research/track-k/check-retained.ts research/track-k/input c14

name: c9
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && bun research/track-k/check-retained.ts research/track-k/input c9

name: c11
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && bun research/track-k/check-retained.ts research/track-k/input c11

name: paxos-r1
cmd: bun install --frozen-lockfile >/dev/null && set -o pipefail; timeout -s KILL 60s bun research/protocols/ic3syn/run.ts --ms 60000 --only paxos_epr --skip broken | tee /tmp/track-k-strict.jsonl; rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}; echo STRICT_EXIT=$rc; test "$rc" -eq 0 && bun -e 'const r=(await Bun.file("/tmp/track-k-strict.jsonl").text()).split("\n").filter(l=>l.startsWith("{")).map(JSON.parse).find(r=>r.id==="paxos_epr");if(r?.search?.verdict!=="proven"||r.search.ms>60000)throw Error("strict target not proven");'
